questions.explanation: A cleared TRIS bit configures the corresponding GPIO as an output in the classic PIC18 model.

questions.q: Which register is the PORTB output latch?
questions.explanation: LATB holds the output latch state for PORTB.

questions.q: How many codes are available in a 10-bit ADC?
questions.explanation: A 10-bit converter represents 2^10 = 1024 codes, normally 0 through 1023.

questions.q: Which timer commonly provides the PWM timebase on classic PIC18 devices?
questions.explanation: CCP PWM commonly uses Timer2 as its timebase.
